mapper.select: select adjudication_id, request_id, discrepancy_case_id, case_version_before, case_version_after, fact_fingerprint, source_confirmation_event_id, target_confirmation_event_id, discrepancy_type, discrepancy_quantity, source_cost_price, discrepancy_amount, decision_fingerprint, adjudication_note, evidence_refs, required_permission, adjudicator_user_id, adjudicator_name, plan_status, create_time from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication where request_id = #{requestId} for update

select adjudication_action_id, adjudication_id, discrepancy_case_id, action_sequence, action_type, coverage_kind, action_quantity, action_amount, responsible_party, action_note, execution_status from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_action where adjudication_id = #{adjudicationId} order by action_sequence
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication ( request_id, discrepancy_case_id, case_version_before, case_version_after, fact_fingerprint, source_confirmation_event_id, target_confirmation_event_id, discrepancy_type, discrepancy_quantity, source_cost_price, discrepancy_amount, decision_fingerprint, adjudication_note, evidence_refs, required_permission, adjudicator_user_id, adjudicator_name, plan_status, create_by, create_time ) select #{adjudication.requestId}, c.discrepancy_case_id, c.case_version, #{adjudication.caseVersionAfter}, c.fact_fingerprint, source_event.confirmation_event_id, target_event.confirmation_event_id, c.discrepancy_type, c.discrepancy_quantity, c.source_cost_price, c.discrepancy_amount, #{adjudication.decisionFingerprint}, #{adjudication.adjudicationNote}, #{adjudication.evidenceRefs}, #{adjudication.requiredPermission}, #{adjudication.adjudicatorUserId}, #{adjudication.adjudicatorName}, 'adjudication_planned', #{adjudication.adjudicatorName}, #{adjudication.createdAt} from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case c inner join inv_transfer_order o on o.transfer_id = c.transfer_id inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event source_event on source_event.confirmation_event_id = #{adjudication.sourceConfirmationEventId} and source_event.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and source_event.party_role = 'source' and source_event.party_dept_id = coalesce( nullif(o.from_warehouse_id, 0), o.from_dept_id) inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event target_event on target_event.confirmation_event_id = #{adjudication.targetConfirmationEventId} and target_event.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and target_event.party_role = 'target' and target_event.party_dept_id = coalesce( nullif(o.to_warehouse_id, 0), o.to_dept_id) where c.discrepancy_case_id = #{adjudication.caseId} and c.case_version = #{adjudication.caseVersionBefore} and c.fact_fingerprint = #{adjudication.factFingerprint} and c.status = 'awaiting_confirmation' and c.discrepancy_type = #{adjudication.discrepancyType} and c.discrepancy_quantity = #{adjudication.discrepancyQuantity} and c.source_cost_price = #{adjudication.sourceCostPrice} and c.discrepancy_amount = #{adjudication.discrepancyAmount} and #{adjudication.requiredPermission} = 'inv:transfer:discrepancy:adjudicate' and #{adjudication.planStatus} = 'adjudication_planned' and length(#{adjudication.adjudicatorName}) between 1 and 64 and #{adjudication.adjudicatorUserId} > 0 and source_event.case_version = c.case_version and target_event.case_version = c.case_version and source_event.fact_fingerprint = c.fact_fingerprint and target_event.fact_fingerprint = c.fact_fingerprint and source_event.decision = 'confirmed' and target_event.decision = 'confirmed' and source_event.operator_user_id <> #{adjudication.adjudicatorUserId} and target_event.operator_user_id <> #{adjudication.adjudicatorUserId} and source_event.confirmation_event_id = ( select max(source_latest.confirmation_event_id) from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event source_latest where source_latest.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and source_latest.party_role = 'source' ) and target_event.confirmation_event_id = ( select max(target_latest.confirmation_event_id) from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_confirmation_event target_latest where target_latest.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and target_latest.party_role = 'target' ) and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication prior where prior.request_id = #{adjudication.requestId} or (prior.discrepancy_case_id = #{adjudication.caseId} and prior.case_version_before = #{adjudication.caseVersionBefore}) )

insert into inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_action ( adjudication_id, discrepancy_case_id, action_sequence, action_type, coverage_kind, action_quantity, action_amount, responsible_party, action_note, execution_status, create_by, create_time ) values
(#{adjudicationId}, #{adjudication.caseId}, #{action.sequence}, #{action.actionType}, #{action.coverageKind}, #{action.quantity}, #{action.amount}, #{action.responsibleParty}, #{action.note}, 'pending', #{adjudication.adjudicatorName}, #{adjudication.createdAt})
